summary: Keep unauthenticated MCP HTTP listeners loopback-only by default and reject live MovieGlu requests unless every required provider header is configured.
reason: A wildcard listener exposes credential-backed tools to network peers, while omitting MovieGlu geolocation defers a deterministic configuration failure to the remote API.
validated_outcome: Regression tests pin the loopback listener and local missing-geolocation error; the purchase-confirmation example uses the API's HH:MM time contract.
